commitResults.messageTitle: Renamed chatbot from Duke to Cookie
commitResults.messageBody:
*Renamed chatbot to Cookie
*Updated all references of Duke to Cookie
*Updated ASCII-art banner to display COOKIE

*Modified Level 0 code to be structured as smaller methods greet() and
exit()
*Added support for echo to allow input until "bye" terminates it

commitResults.messageTitle: Added support for add, list features
Added support for mark/unmark task as done feature
commitResults.messageBody:
*Created a new class Task to contain both description and status instead
of the old String-only description
*Added markTask() and unmarkTask() to support the new feature
*Created a new skill to present code diffs visually
*Updated list() to include checkboxes and a display message.
